question: Does modeling the live-text frames as an Effect Stream add material deployed client latency versus the existing native byte stream?
hypothesis: The adapter refactor leaves first-visible latency and settlement within normal Object-to-Object and same-Object repeat variation.
primaryMetric: Driver submit-start to first nonempty assistant text received by the public CloudflareThreadClient watchText consumer.
secondaryMetrics: Provider first text token to client first text, conditionally calibrated across I/O clocks
Provider last token to complete visible text
Driver submit-start to durable settlement observed

descriptiveAttentionThresholds.qualification: Attention thresholds, not statistical equivalence guarantees. Interpret differences against per-Object and repeat spread; do not claim a speedup from an unpaired cohort difference.

environment.deployment: Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects through private Alchemy stacks

sample.firstTurn: forced Object reconstruction verified by incarnation
sample.secondTurn: retained settling sample, excluded from cold/warm summary

timing: Deployed receipts only. Millisecond I/O clocks; provider-driver lag uses the full observed same-colo echo offset envelope plus 1 ms quantization. Midpoints are conditional estimates. Driver-local first text and settlement do not cross clock domains.
stopRule: One bounded two-variant comparison plus existing resource-lifetime proofs; preserve every failed outcome and do not replay uncertain turn submissions.
productChange: Experiment only; restore the product branch unchanged.
